* Work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and other engineering teams to challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure solutions address the underlying business need.
* Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices across the team, including Git\-based development, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, testing, release management, and documentation.
* Support and mentor other developers and admins, sharing knowledge and helping raise technical standards across the team.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions, reduce technical debt, improve platform performance, and make Salesforce easier to maintain and evolve.
* Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision\-making so that knowledge is shared effectively across the team.

* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL/SOSL.
* Strong Salesforce configuration skills, including Flow, object modelling, validation rules, security, and sharing.
* Experience making or contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions, rather than only implementing predefined solutions.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or similar integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and code review practices.
* Experience working with Git\-based version control and modern Salesforce development and deployment practices.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical or production issues.
* Strong communication skills, with experience working directly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly.
